question: BL-7 / HF-02 decision support: for each of the 8 dual-bound L0 ledger rows at ledger/theorems.jsonl sha256 a1674f094979, which frozen class (if any) is the row's subject, and what is the second class id's relation?
authority_boundary: This pack measures and classifies. It rules nothing, edits no ledger, sets no validation_status, no node status, and no gate verdict. The choice among the recommendations belongs to the controller/A0 owner (review w063-l0-scope-adjudication.json#5db1b10fb3c4 records the pending ruling).
procedure: 1. Pin the six inputs above; abort with exit 3 on any drift measured before the run or after it.

2. Enumerate every row of ledger/theorems.jsonl; the population is every row whose class_ids has length >= 2; assert it equals exactly the 8 named ids (no more, no fewer), and that no row has length > 2.
3. For each row x class_id cell in ASSIGNMENTS.json, ground the assigned relation in the row's own frozen bytes: the quote must occur as a normalized substring of the serialized row JSON.

4. Controls: (C1) population completeness; (C2) every class token is one of the four frozen ids; (C3) key census for transfer_argument on all 62 rows, since the HF-02 detector's only exemption is a transfer_argument; (C4) quote grounding 16/16; (C5) fabrication negative control: substitute the final token of each quote with the sentinel ZZQFABRICATED and require the grounding check to fail (truncation is not usable here: a prefix of a verbatim quote is itself grounded); (C6) order-insensitivity: the per-cell relations keyed by class id must not depend on class_ids list order; (C7) single-bound control on the 54 rows with one or zero class ids.
5. Emit binding_analysis.json with per-row cells, per-row resolution, aggregates, controls, limitations, falsifiers and the reproduction command.
aggregation_rule: Result counts are reported over the 8-row population only; no metric is extrapolated to the 62-row ledger. A ratio such as '4/8 secondary ids are relevance/antecedent' is a description of this population, not a class-binding score for L0.

known_reference_points.review_L0_review_17_current: 8 of 62 rows bind two frozen classes in one class_ids list (the HF-02 'disjunction of class_ids'), and the ledger already uses informs_classes on 7 other rows.
known_reference_points.review_w063_l0_scope: W063-L0S-R3: statement-level scan found 0 positive merge assertions; the second id is relevance, not a merge. W063-L0S-R2: the canonical class_ids scanner does not fire on these rows but does fire on T-402.regularity free text.
known_reference_points.rubric_HF_02: evaluation_rubric.yaml hard_failures HF-02 detector: 'unknown class_id | disjunction of class_ids | evidence metadata violates the class forbidden_evidence list without transfer_argument | conclusion_type not allowed for class'.
known_reference_points.BL_6_needed_to_unblock: 'Per-row adjudication with a source read for each of the 8 disjunctive rows (choose ONE class or move the second to informs_classes) and a binding decision ...' -- this pack supplies the per-row half of that input.

evidence_level: Abstract/metadata-level read only. The row fields and the ledger/citation_audit.csv excerpts are the frozen evidence base; no page-level or theorem-statement check was performed, and no live fetch was made. This matches the rows' own verification_status=abstract-read and does not upgrade it.
falsifiers: F1: any quote assigned to a cell is shown not to occur in the pinned row bytes (grounding control C4/C5 would already have caught a fabrication).
F2: a third party shows from the pinned row bytes or its source that a cell's relation is contradicted (e.g. a row assigned CONTRAST actually asserts that class).
F3: any of the six pinned inputs moves; the whole table then needs re-pinning.

F4: the 8-row population changes (a row's class_ids length crosses 2) at the pinned ledger hash -- impossible without a hash move, but a different ledger hash with a different population voids the table.
F5: a reviewer shows that an INTERMEDIATE_NEITHER row is exactly one of the four frozen classes, or that a SINGLE_SUBJECT row genuinely asserts both classes.
not_claimed: ruling on whether HF-02 applies to record files (worker-063 owns that adjudication input; this pack is content-side only)
